title: New-Year-Resolution Forecast
dataSources: Forecasts (`prediction:forecast`), resolved outcomes (`prediction:outcome`), personal bets (`bet:personal`), calibration scores (`calibration:score`), Brier scores (`brier:score`).
app: Personal forecasting and calibration — a private prediction journal of dated forecasts about your own life, resolved outcomes, and calibration / Brier scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prediction:forecast topic=resolution
| stats avg(confidence) as avg_confidence, count as resolutions, sum(eval(if(status="kept",1,0))) as kept
| eval kept_pct=round(100*kept/resolutions,1)
description: Records your confidence that you will keep each new-year resolution and later scores how many you actually kept.
value: Predicting your own follow-through — and being proven right or wrong — makes next year's resolutions wiser.
implementation: Ingest resolution forecasts into `index=personal`; compare predicted confidence to kept rate.
visualization: Summary panel of resolutions kept versus predicted.
grandmaExplanation: It records how sure you were about keeping each resolution, then shows how many you really kept.
